name: How long does a wind damage evaluation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a wind damage evaluation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a wind damage evaluation can vary depending on the size and complexity of your roof, as well as the extent of visible damage. Typically, a standard evaluation takes between 30 minutes to an an hour. For larger homes or properties with multiple roof sections, the inspection might take longer. Our technicians will provide a more precise estimate on-site, ensuring a thorough assessment without rushing the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: A wind damage evaluation typically takes 30 minutes to an hour, varying by roof size and damage extent. Larger roofs may take longer.
